resource.name: fotufilm-engine
resource.creator: DhaliwalX
resource.category: Color grading, DCTLs, film looks, and color science
resource.description: Film simulation engine with a Resolve OpenFX plugin and Mac app. Stable release v1.7.1-build12; v1.8-alpha adds scanned-negative import and sampled film curves. Includes film profiles with separate CC BY-SA terms.
resource.platformNotes: Mac app requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14+; plugin guide also documents universal builds. Exact Resolve edition/version is not established.

history.name: DhaliwalX/fotufilm-engine
history.summary: Revises cinema-print timing, source illumination and channel contrast behavior. Existing edits may render differently.
changes: Corrects print-layer sensitivity and density targets.
Defaults source illumination to Stock Native, with daylight, tungsten and custom choices.
Separates source light, viewing illumination and print development.
Makes Channel Contrast Match optional and off by default while preserving saved nonzero settings.
